title: Asset table, upload, and listing
description: New asset model + additive Alembic migration on head 4a783e8a1648: filename, label, kind enum (logo/product/screenshot/brand/photo), tags JSONB, width, height, sha256 unique, source_post_id nullable FK, created_at. The new model module MUST be imported in app/models/__init__.py or autogenerate emits a drop. Migrations here are hand-tidied: single quotes, server_default=sa.false() on non-nullable adds, real downgrade() bodies. POST /assets takes a multipart upload, reads dimensions with Pillow, dedupes on sha256 by returning the existing row, and downscales over 1600px long-edge — justified by disk and upload time ONLY; the Cloudflare payload ceiling does not exist (seams.md) and no slice may cite it. Reuse media.py's _KNOWN_SUFFIXES (:15) and _suffix() (:31-43) for the licdn no-extension case, but NOT media.py:82-84's swallow-all-return-None: an upload must 4xx on failure. GET /assets filters by kind and tag in the bare-kwarg style of /posts (main.py:102-113), 422 with allowed values in detail.
acceptanceCriteria: migration is additive: one new table, no drop_* and no column type change; downgrade() is real
app/models/__init__.py imports the new module and autogenerate produces no drop
re-uploading an identical file returns the existing row rather than a duplicate
an oversized image is stored downscaled with its real stored dimensions recorded
an unreadable or non-image upload returns 4xx, never a silent None
make check green
slice tests green

title: One asset-resolution function, wired into all three render call sites
description: Resolve image_url slots from asset ids into base64 data: URIs and embed them on the html render path — the remote Cloudflare renderer cannot reach localhost. Base64 is load-bearing: fill() escapes slot values, a base64 URI survives byte-identical, and a raw SVG data URI is mangled to <svg with NO exception raised (the silent-broken-visual class that retired stat-hero v1). Encode base64-only with a ponytail: comment naming why, and do NOT widen fill(escape=False) on the markup path — that is the injection guard for model-written text. CRITICAL: render_visual has THREE consumers, not one — generation._draw_visual (:189, reached from generate_draft :240 AND regenerate_visual :282, which takes no values argument so it must read from the draft) and api_templates.preview_visual (:161), which takes values straight from the request body with no writable_slots filter and is already called by TemplateManager.tsx:105. Resolution must be ONE shared function used by all three, or generation works while every image-template preview 422s. Slot dicts must be read with .get('type') — VISUAL row 556 has no `type` key at all.
acceptanceCriteria: one resolution function is used by generate_draft, regenerate_visual and preview_visual
a visual template with an image_url slot renders a real embedded image end-to-end
regenerating a visual preserves its assets rather than losing them
previewing an image template returns an image, not a 422
a test asserts the base64 URI reaches the renderer intact — follow renderer_capturing (tests/test_rendering.py:33-41), NOT FakeRenderer (test_generation.py:31-38) which discards the html argument
a raw non-base64 SVG data URI is rejected loudly rather than silently mangled
reading a slot with no `type` key does not raise
fill()'s escape=True markup path is unchanged
make check green
slice tests green

title: Cloudflare renderer backs off on 429
description: CloudflareRenderer.screenshot calls raise_for_status() with no 429 handling (rendering.py:94-103). Free-tier Browser Rendering rate-limits by request cadence and returns 429 code 2001, indistinguishable from a payload rejection — it already caused one phantom size-limit diagnosis during seam verification. Add retry-with-backoff inside the renderer so no caller sees it, and assert it without real sleeping.
acceptanceCriteria: a faked 429 sequence retries then succeeds, via MockTransport, with no real sleep in the test
a non-429 4xx/5xx still raises immediately
backoff lives in the renderer, not in any caller
make check green
slice tests green

description: The payoff slice. Give image_url slots a picker in Studio, persist to a new Draft.asset_values JSONB (additive), let a template slot carry an optional default_asset_id (4th optional key in Template.slots JSONB, no migration) so it completes unattended, and thread asset_values through publishing.lineage_metadata (:19) so asset lineage survives outside our database. WRITABLE_SLOT_TYPES stays {text, number} — the model still never writes an image slot; note generation._written_values (:170-172) also drops volunteered image_url values post-hoc. SECOND HALF, equally important: run_autonomous calls generate_draft with no visual_id, so suggest_templates may LLM-pick stat-hero v2 (two image_url slots); _draw_visual swallows the failure into visual_error (:191-193) and result.created += 1 still fires, so the notifier reports 'N drafts created' with no signal the visual failed. RunResult must surface _draw_visual failures, or 'it works' stays indistinguishable from 'it silently didn't'. Draft.asset_values must also be added to the hand-mapped DraftOut (api_drafts.py:33-47) and its builder (:72-87) or it is invisible to the frontend.

title: Publish detection — stamp went_live_at, and do not trust the analytics window
description: Add went_live_at to Draft (additive). NAMED went_live_at, NOT published_at, because Draft.published_at would shadow Post.published_at (post.py:40) and be silently wrong in any select(Draft, Post) merge with no error. Detect the transition after record_snapshots (metrics.py:95) and before the return (:97). THE TRAP: sync_metrics reads only source.fetch_posts() (:86), Zernio's 50-row analytics window, and 11 published posts already have no analytics row at all — a post publishing outside the window would never be stamped and queue 3 would show it awaiting-publish forever with no error. Detection must therefore scan drafts with zernio_post_id set against Post by late_post_id across the whole table, not only touched ids (note :91 keys on Post.zernio_id, a different namespace, so a detection pass must re-key). The predicate is Post.status == 'published', NOT row existence: analytics also carries partial and failed, and corpus.py writes status='external' for manual rows. sync_metrics does not commit — callers do (scheduler.py:29, main.py:309) — so do not add a commit here. Do not add a DraftStatus enum: pushed_at/went_live_at already derive every state and a status column could disagree. Expose went_live_at through DraftOut (:33-47, :72-87).
acceptanceCriteria: the column is went_live_at and does not shadow Post.published_at
a published post whose analytics row is absent from the window is still detected
a post with status partial/failed/external is NOT treated as published
stamping is idempotent — re-running does not restamp
sync_metrics still does not commit; existing max(observed, stored) metric semantics preserved
went_live_at is exposed through DraftOut
no DraftStatus enum is introduced
make check green
slice tests green

title: Recorded verdicts feed back into generation as lessons

title: Loading, empty and error states across every page
description:
There is no loading.tsx or error.tsx anywhere and no Suspense; loading is an ad-hoc busy useState and errors are four copies of a local red

Now that US-003 makes failure distinguishable from emptiness, give every page real states: Skeleton while loading, a purposeful empty state saying what to do next, and an error state with a retry reporting the actual failure.
